Generic Precision Smooth Cloth  Mouse Pad (Rubber Base / Optimized Tracking Surface / Black Finish)

Enhance your everyday mouse tracking accuracy and office workflow efficiency with the Generic Precision Smooth Cloth Gaming Mouse Pad, available at Turbo Computer Egypt. Engineered with a ultra-smooth high-density weave cloth surface, this essential desktop accessory provides flawless sensor sliding for both optical and laser gaming mice. The base is constructed with a heavy-duty natural rubber compound designed with an anti-slip texture profile to grip your desk firmly and prevent pad movement during swift hand motions. Featuring stitched outer edge reinforcement to resist fraying over time, this minimalist black mouse pad offers exceptional comfort and long-lasting durability for daily work and gaming setups.
